svg.aria-label: Wall time per run of each agent, a panel per toolkit. Each bar is the median wall time with the median time in hyprmasq's tools inside it, and each dot one run.
svg.title: Wall time per run of each agent, a panel per toolkit. Each bar is the median wall time with the median time in hyprmasq's tools inside it, and each dot one run.
svg.text: Each bar is a median wall time, written at the right. Its blue part is the median time in hyprmasq's
MCP tools, and the grey part fills the bar up to the median wall time. Each dot is one run.
A dot past the end of its axis is a run off the scale, more than twice its row's median.
All runs ran at medium effort.
rest of the median wall time
